introTitle: Never forget a restaurant you visited
introBody: FindEat can recognize when you've spent time at a restaurant and remind you afterwards to share your experience.
disclosureBody: FindEat uses location region monitoring to recognize possible restaurant visits, including while the app isn't open. Your device reports restaurant entry and exit events instead of maintaining a detailed route history.
privacyPromise: FindEat stores only the restaurant, approximate entry and exit time, duration, and reminder status. You can disable this at any time.
permissionErrorBody: Check location and notification permissions in your phone settings, then try again.
settingsIntroBody: Get a gentle reminder after a likely restaurant visit, then choose whether to create a post or review.
toggleHint: Automatically recognize likely restaurant visits and remind you afterwards.
mutedPlacesHint: Places that never trigger visit reminders
privacyExplanation: FindEat does not store your movement history, routes, home, or workplace. Visit candidates remain on this device.

mode.FULLHint: Visits can be recognized in the background, subject to your phone's system limits.
mode.FOREGROUND: Detection works while FindEat is open
mode.FOREGROUNDHint: Background location isn't enabled. FindEat can still recognize possible visits while you're using the app.
mode.UNAVAILABLEHint: Enable location and notification access to use Visit Detection.

mutedPlacesDescription: Muted places still work normally everywhere else in FindEat. They simply won't create automatic visit reminders.
noMutedPlacesHint: Places you mute from a visit reminder will appear here.
reminderBody: Want to share how it was?
createContentHint: Share photos or a short video
writeReviewHint: Rate the food and your experience
dontRemindPlace: Don't remind me about this place
staleTitle: This reminder is no longer available
staleBody: It may have already been handled, or the restaurant is no longer available.
